Name: More COD-Inspired Fish
Author: Florain030
Description:
[heading]MORE COD-INSPIRED FISH[/heading]
Adds seven ocean fish inspired by Call of Duty characters.

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/52606/52606-1790419909-605612269.png[/img]

• Fish ponds with distinctive water colors and special produce.
• Aquarium support, including hats for your fish.
• New villager gift preferences.
• Simplified Chinese and English support, following your game's language setting.

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/52606/52606-1790419907-1206095329.png[/img]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/52606/52606-1790419912-1506196172.png[/img]

[heading]REQUIREMENTS[/heading]
• Stardew Valley 1.6.15 or later
• SMAPI 4.5.1 or later
• Content Patcher 2.9.0 or later — required starting with mod version 1.6.0

[heading]INSTALLATION AND UPDATES[/heading]
1. Install SMAPI and Content Patcher.
2. Close the game. Back up your save before updating.
3. When updating, completely remove the old cod fishing mod folder before installing the new version. Do not merge the folders.
4. Extract the cod fishing mod folder from the download into your game's Mods folder. Keep the Content and Runtime subfolders inside it.
5. Launch the game through SMAPI.

Updating preserves your existing fish and current ordinary quest progress.

[heading]更多鱼类-COD版[/heading]
以《使命召唤》角色为原型，增加了7种海洋鱼类

• 拥有不同水色与特别产物的鱼塘，
• 支持放入鱼缸及佩戴帽子
• 新增村民礼物喜好
• 支持简体中文与英文，随游戏语言切换。

[heading]安装要求[/heading]
• Stardew Valley 1.6.15 或更高版本
• SMAPI 4.5.1 或更高版本
• Content Patcher 2.9.0 或更高版本——模组 1.6.0 起需要此项前置

[heading]安装与更新[/heading]
1. 安装 SMAPI 与 Content Patcher。
2. 退出游戏；更新前备份存档。
3. 更新时先完整移除旧的 cod fishing mod 文件夹，再安装新版，不要覆盖合并。
4. 将下载包里的 cod fishing mod 文件夹解压到游戏的 Mods 文件夹，保留其中的 Content 与 Runtime 两个子文件夹。
5. 通过 SMAPI 启动游戏。

更新会保留现有鱼类与当前普通任务进度。
